values./system/description:
A makeshift weapon, normally seen in the hands of those who can’t make, buy, or scavenge anything better, pipe guns are crude and somewhat unreliable, but effective enough. Bolt-action pipe guns tend to be chambered for rifle caliber rounds, trading rate-of-fire for power and simplicity.

A Pipe Bolt-Action can accept one each of the following mods. You may not take both a Grip and a Stock Mod. Any Stock mods add the word “Rifle” to the end of the weapon’s name.

  • Receiver: Calibrated, Hardened, Powerful, .38 Receiver, .50 Receiver
  • Barrel: Long Barrel, Ported Barrel, Finned Barrel
  • Grip: Sharpshooter’s Grip
  • Stock: Full Stock, Marksman’s Stock, RecoilCompensating Stock
  • Sights: Reflex Sight, Short Scope, Long Scope, Short Night Vision Scope, Long Night Vision Scope, Recon Scope
  • Muzzle: Bayonet, Compensator, Muzzle Brake, Suppressor
